mentions.name: Running performance analytics platform
mentions.description: A performance analytics platform for runners that provides personalised, performance-based models rather than social features. Features include personalised adjusted-speed models updated weekly, effort-pace modelling for surface types, heat and humidity, an omniduration model estimating critical speed/LT1/LT2/VO2max and race performances, training-session fitness-effect modelling (base/aerobic, threshold, VO2max, anaerobic), course- and weather-aware race time predictions with splits, and cohort-adjusted performance comparisons by age and training volume. It is running only, focused on individuals rather than teams or coaches.
mentions.problem: No one currently offers decent performance-modelling tools for amateur runners: pro tools are unavailable to them, and existing options like Strava (social, ill-fitting GAP model) and TrainingPeaks (team/coach focused, one-size-fits-all) don't provide personalised analytics for individuals.
mentions.audience: Fairly decent amateur runners (e.g. sub 3-hour marathoners) who already know quite a bit about training but don't have a coach and are not good enough to be pro with a full support team.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a running app. Mainly for me but others have expressed interest.

It's a performance analytics platform for runners who love to dive into the details after they've been for a run and to be able to accurately track their progress over time.
